title.en: They Stopped Selling. They Started Billing.

caption.en: A company that once sold a box, once. Now it sends a bill every month.
caption.ko: 한 번 팔고 끝나던 회사. 지금은 매달 청구서를 보낸다.

moral.en: A product sells once. A habit bills every month.
moral.ko: 물건은 한 번 팔린다. 습관은 매달 청구된다.

narration.en: It sold a box. Once. That was the whole business.
narration.ko: 한 번 팔고 끝나는 장사였다. 그게 전부였다.

image_hint.en: city street at dusk, billboard of a software company, one person walking past, distant figure

scenes.image_prompt: city street at dusk, billboard of a software company, one person walking past, distant figure

narration.en: Money came only with the next version. Nobody waited that long.
narration.ko: 다음 버전이 나와야 돈이 됐다. 손님은 기다려주지 않았다.

narration.en: A plastic case landed on office desks. Install nights ran long.
narration.ko: 사무실 책상 위에 케이스가 놓였다. 설치하던 밤은 길었다.

image_hint.en: office desk at night, one person installing software, seen from behind

narration.en: One by one, companies looked somewhere else.

narration.en: The graph went flat. People said it was finished.
narration.ko: 매출 그래프가 평평해졌다. 끝났다는 말이 돌았다.

narration.en: Then the selling changed. Not sold anymore. Rented by the month.
narration.ko: 그때 판매 방식이 바뀐다. 팔지 않고, 매달 받는다.

narration.en: Renewal dates came around quietly. Nobody installed anything.
narration.ko: 갱신일이 조용히 돌아온다. 아무도 설치하지 않는다.
